method: built-in image_gen; deterministic alpha-cell packing with sharp

prompts.base: Edit target: the provided four-pose sprite sheet of Lin Jian, a young adult Chinese male customs intern. Preserve his identity, face, hairstyle, light blue short-sleeve customs uniform, navy long trousers, black belt and black dress shoes, warm hand-painted anime illustration style. Replace the sheet layout and poses with a production-ready NINE-frame sprite atlas, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows, all cells equal, portrait character proportions, transparent background with true alpha. Full body in every cell, NO labels, NO numbers, NO borders, NO floor or shadow, NO props. All nine views are STRICT SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT, same camera, same scale, same head, pelvis horizontally centered, feet aligned to same floor baseline with generous gutters. Cell order reading left to right: cell0 relaxed standing idle with feet together; cell1 WALK contact A: NEAR visible leg reaching forward RIGHT heel first, FAR leg extended behind LEFT toe down, opposite arm swing; cell2 WALK down A: weight on near front leg, rear far foot lifting; cell3 WALK passing A: FAR knee travels forward past planted NEAR leg; cell4 WALK up A: FAR knee raised forward, NEAR leg behind supporting; cell5 WALK contact B: FAR leg now reaches forward RIGHT heel first, NEAR visible leg extends behind LEFT toe down, arms reversed from cell1; cell6 WALK down B: weight on far front leg, near rear foot lifts; cell7 WALK passing B: NEAR knee travels forward past planted FAR leg; cell8 WALK up B: NEAR knee raised forward, FAR leg behind supporting. CRITICAL: frames1-4 must alternate into frames5-8 with the OTHER LEG. Distinguish near leg with normal blue fabric and far leg with slightly darker shaded blue. Do not duplicate near-leg-forward poses for both contacts. Both arms counter-swing naturally opposite the legs. Small knee bends, anatomically plausible grounded walking, no running, jumping, bent torso or skates. Clean sharp transparent cutout edges. This atlas will be played in order frames1 through8 repeatedly, frame0 only when idle.
prompts.opposite: Edit target/reference is Lin Jian's sprite atlas. Create ONLY the OPPOSITE half of his walking cycle, four frames in an exact 2 by 2 equal-cell grid on transparent background. Same young male customs intern identity, strict side profile facing RIGHT, same blue short-sleeved uniform, navy trousers, black shoes, full body with head and feet not clipped, same head height, no text/borders/shadow. Crucial correction: in ALL four images the ARM CLOSEST TO CAMERA is swept BACKWARD toward the LEFT, behind his back/hip. The closer hand must be clearly on the LEFT of his belt buckle (not reaching right). The FAR ARM points forward RIGHT partly hidden behind torso. This must be the reverse of the arm swing in the supplied atlas. Pose1 top-left: FAR LEG forward to RIGHT heel on ground; NEAR LEG swept backward LEFT, toe on ground, clearly draw the nearer thigh/leg trailing behind body to left. Pose2 top-right: FAR leg bears weight in front, NEAR leg behind with heel lifting and knee bending. Pose3 bottom-left: NEAR bent knee passes behind far supporting calf moving forward, both feet near pelvis center. Pose4 bottom-right: NEAR knee begins swinging forward but has not fully extended, FAR leg is supporting behind. Visible nearer leg fabric medium navy, far leg darker navy for unambiguous alternating limb depth. Arms remain reverse-swung compared to provided atlas. Avoid creating another right-arm-forward lunge; do not repeat provided poses. Do not change costume or face.
